sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM marts.dim_customers LIMIT 1000
SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM marts.dim_customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders_2025 FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS revenue_2025_eur FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000
SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) AS INT) AS fiscal_year, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS revenue_eur FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 1000

SELECT order_month, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue_eur FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue = TRUE AND order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY order_month LIMIT 1000

SELECT c.company_name, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM marts.fct_orders AS o JOIN marts.dim_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.company_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS net_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.net_amount) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN marts.dim_products AS p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE o.is_revenue GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue) / COUNT(*), 2) AS average_order_value_eur FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT p.category, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(l.net_amount - l.cogs) / NULLIF(SUM(l.net_amount), 0), 2) AS gross_margin_pct FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN marts.dim_products AS p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category LIMIT 1000

SELECT r.region, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue_2025 FROM marts.fct_orders AS o JOIN marts.dim_sales_reps AS r ON r.sales_rep_id = o.sales_rep_id WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY r.region ORDER BY net_revenue_2025 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_without_completed_order FROM marts.dim_customers WHERE first_order_date IS NULL LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_product_count FROM marts.dim_products WHERE is_active = TRUE LIMIT 1000

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(l.quantity) AS units_sold FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN marts.dim_products AS p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE method = 'card') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS card_payment_pct FROM marts.fct_payments LIMIT 1000

SELECT p.method AS payment_method, COUNT(*) AS payment_count, ROUND(CAST(AVG(p.paid_at - o.order_date) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_days_to_pay FROM marts.fct_payments AS p JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = p.order_id GROUP BY p.method ORDER BY p.method LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_with_discount_2025 FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND discount_amount > 0 LIMIT 1000

SELECT c.segment, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue_2025 FROM marts.fct_orders AS o JOIN marts.dim_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY net_revenue_2025 DESC LIMIT 1000
SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) AS INT) AS creation_year, COUNT(*) AS accounts_created FROM marts.dim_customers GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 1000

SELECT order_month, COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue = TRUE AND order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY completed_orders DESC, order_month LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status = 'returned') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS returned_order_pct FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS de_q4_2025_net_revenue_eur FROM marts.fct_orders AS o JOIN marts.dim_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE AND c.country = 'DE' AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-10-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.shipping_fee), 2) AS total_shipping_fees_eur FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_order_count FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE status = 'open' LIMIT 1000

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_over_50k_revenue_2025 FROM (SELECT o.customer_id FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING SUM(o.net_revenue) > 50000) AS c LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(o.item_count) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_items_per_completed_order FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.discount_amount), 2) AS total_discount_eur FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS discontinued_net_revenue_eur FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN marts.dim_products AS p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE AND p.is_active = FALSE LIMIT 1000

WITH yearly AS (SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) AS INT) AS order_year, SUM(net_revenue) AS net_revenue FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue AND order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY 1) SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN net_revenue END), 2) AS revenue_2024_eur, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN net_revenue END), 2) AS revenue_2025_eur, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN net_revenue END) - SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN net_revenue END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN net_revenue END) * 100, 2) AS revenue_growth_pct FROM yearly LIMIT 1000
SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS sales_rep_count FROM marts.dim_sales_reps GROUP BY region ORDER BY region LIMIT 1000

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_lapsed_after_2024 FROM (SELECT o.customer_id FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) EXCEPT SELECT o.customer_id FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)) AS lapsed LIMIT 1000

SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount - l.cogs), 2) AS gross_margin_eur FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN marts.dim_products AS p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY gross_margin_eur DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT ROUND(CAST(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.net_revenue) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS median_net_order_value_eur FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT method, COUNT(*) AS payment_count, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_amount FROM marts.fct_payments WHERE paid_at >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND paid_at < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY method ORDER BY method LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE sales_rep_id = 3 AND order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT c.country AS country, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue_eur FROM marts.fct_orders AS o JOIN marts.dim_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE AND c.segment = 'enterprise' AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY net_revenue_eur DESC LIMIT 1000
SELECT o.customer_id, MIN(o.order_date) AS first_completed_order_date FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.customer_id = 42 AND o.is_revenue = TRUE GROUP BY o.customer_id LIMIT 1000

WITH rev_2025 AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(net_revenue) AS customer_revenue FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue AND order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY customer_id), top10 AS (SELECT customer_revenue FROM rev_2025 ORDER BY customer_revenue DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT SUM(customer_revenue) FROM top10) / (SELECT SUM(customer_revenue) FROM rev_2025), 2) AS top10_customer_revenue_share_pct LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id), 2) AS avg_revenue_per_customer_2025_eur FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.product_id) AS distinct_products_ordered FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN marts.dim_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'FR' AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

WITH yearly_revenue AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2024 THEN net_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS rev_2024, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2025 THEN net_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS rev_2025 FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue AND order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_below_half_revenue FROM yearly_revenue WHERE rev_2024 > 0 AND rev_2025 < 0.5 * rev_2024 LIMIT 1000

WITH c2024 AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue AND order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)), c2025 AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue AND order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)) SELECT COUNT(c2024.customer_id) AS customers_completed_2024, COUNT(c2025.customer_id) AS customers_also_completed_2025, ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COUNT(c2025.customer_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(c2024.customer_id), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS pct_also_completed_2025 FROM c2024 LEFT JOIN c2025 ON c2025.customer_id = c2024.customer_id LIMIT 1000

WITH monthly AS (SELECT order_month, SUM(net_revenue) AS revenue FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue GROUP BY order_month), with_prev AS (SELECT order_month, revenue, LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY order_month) AS prev_revenue FROM monthly) SELECT order_month, ROUND(revenue, 2) AS net_revenue, ROUND(100.0 * (revenue - prev_revenue) / NULLIF(prev_revenue, 0), 2) AS mom_growth_pct FROM with_prev WHERE order_month >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_month < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) ORDER BY order_month LIMIT 1000

SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2024 THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS revenue_2024, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2025 THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS revenue_2025, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2025 THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2024 THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS revenue_increase_eur FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN marts.dim_products AS p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE o.is_revenue GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue_increase_eur DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.discount_pct > 0 THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(l.net_amount), 0), 2) AS discounted_revenue_share_pct FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT COUNT(*) AS late_invoice_payments FROM marts.fct_payments AS p JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE p.method = 'invoice' AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND (p.paid_at - o.order_date) > 30 LIMIT 1000

SELECT o.sales_rep_id AS employee_number, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS revenue_2025 FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.sales_rep_id IS NOT NULL AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.sales_rep_id ORDER BY revenue_2025 DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_first_completed_order_2025 FROM marts.dim_customers WHERE first_order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND first_order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

WITH enterprise_completed AS (SELECT o.customer_id, o.order_id, o.order_date FROM marts.fct_orders AS o JOIN marts.dim_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE AND c.segment = 'enterprise'), order_gaps AS (SELECT order_date - LAG(order_date) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date, order_id) AS days_between FROM enterprise_completed) SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(days_between) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_days_between_orders, COUNT(*) AS order_pairs FROM order_gaps WHERE days_between IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.gross_margin) / NULLIF(SUM(o.net_revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000
